data: For fiscal 2025, Apple came out ahead of NVIDIA on net income. Apple reported net income of about $112.0 billion for its fiscal year ended September 27, 2025, up from roughly $93.7 billion in fiscal 2024. NVIDIA reported net income of about $72.9 billion for its fiscal 2025, which ended January 26, 2025, up 145% from $29.8 billion in fiscal 2024. That makes Apple's figure about 1.54 times NVIDIA's, a gap of roughly $39 billion. The two fiscal years are labeled the same but cover different periods. NVIDIA's fiscal 2025 runs from roughly February 2024 to January 2025, while Apple's runs from October 2024 to September 2025. NVIDIA's profits grew quickly after that period, so its later fiscal 2026, ended January 2026, closes much or all of the gap. A comparison over matching calendar periods would therefore look quite different.
